Pfizer's fiscal Q4 2025 capital expenditures were roughly **$750 million**. This is an estimate, not a figure I can confirm from the filings.

- **How it was derived:** Pfizer reports capital expenditures as "purchases of property, plant and equipment" in its cash flow statement. Q4 would normally be the full-year 2025 total minus the nine-month year-to-date total. I don't have either 2025 figure reliably.
- **Basis for the estimate:** Full-year 2024 purchases were about $2.9 billion, and I believe 2025 spending was somewhat lower, perhaps around $2.4 billion. That puts a typical quarter at roughly $600–$750 million, and fourth quarters often run higher, so I took the upper end of that range.
